title: AI/ML Engineer
description: Build, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and artificial intelligence systems using data, software engineering, and model operations.

title: Data Scientist
description: Use statistics, programming, and machine learning to analyze complex datasets, build predictive models, and communicate evidence-based findings.

title: Data Analyst
description: Query, clean, and interpret business data with spreadsheets, SQL, and reporting tools, then present actionable insights to stakeholders.

title: Backend Developer
description: Design and build reliable server-side applications, APIs, data access layers, and authentication for web and mobile products.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Create accessible, responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and component-based web frameworks.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Build complete web applications across frontend interfaces, backend APIs, databases, and deployment workflows.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate software delivery and infrastructure operations using cloud platforms, containers, testing, and reliable deployment pipelines.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Provision, secure, and operate scalable cloud infrastructure, services, and application environments.

title: Data Engineer
description: Develop data pipelines and platforms that collect, transform, validate, and deliver reliable data for analytics and machine learning.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Build the infrastructure and automation for reproducible machine learning training, deployment, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build systems that process and understand human language using machine learning, language models, retrieval, and evaluation.

title: QA Engineer
description: Improve product quality through test planning, manual and automated testing, defect analysis, and collaboration with engineering teams.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor security events, investigate vulnerabilities and incidents, and help protect systems, networks, and sensitive information.

title: Product Manager
description: Set product direction, prioritize customer problems, coordinate delivery across teams, and use research and metrics to guide decisions.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Transform business questions into trusted reports and dashboards using SQL, spreadsheets, data visualization, and stakeholder communication.

title: Automation Engineer
description: Automate repetitive business and engineering workflows through scripting, APIs, browser automation, and robust testing.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description: Develop AI agent applications that combine language models, tools, retrieval, APIs, and workflow automation with measurable safeguards.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description: Build, test, and maintain mobile applications with modern programming languages, user interface frameworks, APIs, and release processes.

title: Database Administrator
description: Maintain database reliability, security, performance, backups, and access while supporting application and analytics teams.

title: UX Designer
description: Research user needs and design usable, accessible digital experiences through interaction design, prototyping, testing, and collaboration.
